label: prf:quantum-characteristic-classes-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of quantum characteristic classes
html: Fix the central extension 1 \to \mathcal{B} \to \mathfrak{G}_{n+1} \to \mathfrak{G}_n \to 1 and the global object g of \mathfrak{G}_n to be lifted. Two choices of local lifts of g differ on each open set by a section of \mathcal{B}, and the resulting obstruction cocycles differ by the Čech coboundary of that 1-cochain [yekutieli2010]. Refining the cover does not change the class. So \kappa_n depends only on the extension and on g, not on the trivialisation.
